name: delirium-policy-microsite
description: Task-first bedside reference for the draft Delirium policy, built from the policy markdown with the NHS design system. Static site for GitHub Pages.

scripts.check: node src/build.mjs && node -e "import('./src/lib/check-links.mjs').then(m => { const r = m.checkLinks('docs'); if (r.errors.length) { console.error(r.errors.join('\n')); process.exit(1) } console.log('ok') })"
